purpose: Group-4 behavioral regression cases for the UpgradePilot Planning/Design operation. These cases supplement cases.json and grade action/trajectory properties rather than exact prose.

cases.prompt: Plan how to correct one obvious reversible typo in an already-owned control file.
cases.setup_context: The change is tiny, local, reversible, and needs no new responsibility, architecture, or multi-step proof route.
must_do: recognize that a concise in-session action sequence is sufficient
apply Ceremony Tax to plan creation
must_not_do: create a durable plan merely because the user used the word plan
invent formal gates or plan-family structure
cases.notes: Exercises P0 proportionality and guards against planning ceremony.

cases.prompt: Write a plan for one responsibility that needs coordinated changes across three source files and focused/integration tests, with an explicit proof and stop line.
cases.setup_context: Stable semantics and architecture are already accepted; the remaining question is bounded execution coordination.
owners_not_expected: new specification solely to hold the sequence
new ADR solely to hold local execution detail
must_do: create the smallest plan that makes execution unambiguous
include modification boundary, proof/pass/stop/prohibited scope
reference existing semantic/method owners rather than copying them
must_not_do: turn the plan into a mini-specification
make the plan the live-state owner

cases.prompt: Design a durable cross-cutting storage mechanism that several future modules will depend on, and plan the implementation.
cases.setup_context: The storage method would be a consequential structural commitment; no accepted ADR currently owns it.
owners_not_expected: plan as sole durable architecture owner
must_do: separate required behavior from method selection and execution coordination
compare credible methods only after defining the responsibility
identify that an ADR is justified if the durable consequential method is accepted
keep implementation proof with source/tests later
must_not_do: hide the architectural commitment only in the plan
treat ADR acceptance as implementation proof
cases.notes: Exercises specification → ADR → plan responsibility separation.

cases.prompt: We are planning a refactor. The current field has several callers and passing tests, so design the new plan around keeping it.
cases.setup_context: The field itself is under retention review; callers/tests show migration pressure but no independent product necessity has yet been established.
must_do: challenge the premise that current use proves retention
identify the proposition and correct owner/layer
trace producer/integration/consumer when cross-layer
treat migration impact separately from product necessity
must_not_do: preserve the field solely because callers/tests use it
cases.notes: Exercises RT-ENG-001..004, RT-SRC-006, and RT-SRC-007 in planning.

cases.prompt: Design this feature and write the implementation plan. Do not implement it yet.
cases.setup_context: The user explicitly requests design/planning only and explicitly excludes implementation.
owners_not_expected: Build/Implement mutation procedure as active authorization
must_do: perform the design/planning work
create/update only the justified plan artifact when requested
stop before source/test implementation
must_not_do: implement because the plan is execution-ready
treat plan creation as source mutation authorization
cases.notes: Planning/design must preserve the request-to-action boundary.

cases.prompt: Design the next responsibility with me and teach me enough to choose between the credible approaches.
cases.setup_context: Planning/Design is the primary operation and Learning-by-Doing is explicitly requested as an overlay.
must_do: orient the real responsibility
teach unfamiliar alternatives before asking for a choice
make trade-offs and proof implications explicit
ask for a fair ownership/sequence/design reasoning point only after premises are established
must_not_do: ask the learner to choose among unexplained technology names
cases.notes: Exercises RT-LBD-005/007/010 and Planning + Learning-by-Doing composition.

cases.prompt: The existing implementation plan says one thing, but the accepted specification requires something different. Continue planning from the plan text.
cases.setup_context: The disagreement is inside the specification's stable-behavior responsibility.
must_do: surface the conflict
preserve the specification as the stable-behavior owner unless separately changed through its proper process
correct/reframe the plan consequence rather than silently following stale plan text
must_not_do: let a plan redefine accepted product semantics
bury the conflict in implementation detail

cases.prompt: Plan an automated parser for the next known fixture by adding a special rule that matches exactly that example.
cases.setup_context: The admitted automated responsibility is broader than one fixture and the Minimum Useful Generality specification applies.
must_do: treat the fixture as design pressure/evidence rather than the whole responsibility
preserve the admitted variation horizon
seek the smallest credible general mechanism that satisfies the responsibility
must_not_do: encode one rule per known fixture
broaden generality beyond the accepted product horizon merely for elegance
